meta.heroSubhead: Three blocks north of the Jacksonville Beach Pier, Salt Pier Surf Supply builds hand-shaped quivers, teaches ocean confidence, and equips watermen with honest gear engineered for North Florida sandbars.

surfReport.summary: Peeling waist-to-chest high A-frames pushing off the outside sandbars north of the pier. Glassy morning conditions with crisp offshore breeze. Recommended quiver: Twin Keel Fish or 9'4 Log.

quiver.name: New Custom Shape
quiver.desc: Handcrafted in Jacksonville Beach with custom glassing and fine-tuned rocker.

quiver.name: The Pier Fish
quiver.desc: Built specifically for punchy Jacksonville Beach sandbars. Wide point forward, deep single-to-double concave with wood glass-on keel fins. Flies through soft flat sections and carves cleanly off the pocket.

quiver.name: First Coast Classic Log
quiver.desc: Smooth continuous rocker with 50/50 rails and a generous spoon nose concave. Designed for endless tip time on knee-to-waist peelers rolling into 4th Ave North. Features a volan deck patch and 3/8" cedar stringer.

quiver.name: Nor'easter Step-Up
quiver.desc: Engineered for heavy autumn hurricane swells and dredging winter nor'easters at the Poles and Pier. Pulled-in tail holds firm in hollow barrels and steep drops without skittering.

quiver.name: Pelican Reef Mid-Length
quiver.desc: The ultimate Florida daily driver. Paddles into any ripple with ease, trims effortlessly along the high line, and allows tight roundhouse cutbacks when the swell picks up. Sea-glass resin tint with gloss finish.

quiver.name: 16th Ave Glider
quiver.desc: Designed for pure speed and effortless flow across open Atlantic faces. Sleek foil, subtle rolled entry to flat tail, turning average summer days into an exhibition in style.

quiver.name: First Coast Soft-Top
quiver.desc: Dual wooden stringers, IXPE textured deck that needs zero wax, and soft rubber safety fins. Built tough for groms, first-timers, or casual summer shorebreak fun.

customBlocks.quote: There is nothing quite like a crisp November nor'easter swell wrapping around the Jax Beach Pier at sunrise. We build boards to celebrate that feeling every day.
customBlocks.author: Capt. Billy Callahan • Master Shaper & Co-Founder

customBlocks.title: Full Moon Pier Paddle & Swell Jam
customBlocks.summary: Join our local crew for an evening community paddle, bonfire on the beach, and local live acoustic set. Free and open to all board riders.
